ev.q: Sixteen cases of acute kidney injury following exposure to SCs were identified in six states

five of the 16 patients required hemodialysis

methods_quotes.q: Review of medical records, follow-up interviews with several patients, and laboratory analysis of product samples and clinical specimens were performed.
